embedded.reason: Small bounded metadata belongs directly to the threat and is normally read together with it.
embedded.embedded_alternative: Keep tier, category and confidence in the threat document.

embedded.reason: Small threat-specific metadata is naturally represented as an array inside the threat document.
embedded.embedded_alternative: Keep tags as an array in the threat document.

referenced.reason: IOCs are reusable, potentially high-cardinality objects that may belong to multiple threats.
referenced.embedded_alternative: Embed IOC objects in every threat. This improves locality but duplicates data and makes global IOC updates harder.

referenced.reason: Sources are shared across many threats and should not be duplicated in every threat.
referenced.embedded_alternative: Copy source metadata into every threat, increasing duplication and update cost.

referenced.reason: One report can describe many threats and may contain larger Markdown content.
referenced.embedded_alternative: Embed report content into threats, increasing document size and duplication.

16mb_verification.rule: All analyzed documents remain below MongoDB's 16 MiB BSON document limit.
